item.title: This content creator is growing softness in hard times

item.title: Rev. Jesse Jackson, trailblazing civil rights icon and LGBTQ+ rights ally, dead at 84
item.description: The Rev. Jesse Jackson died Tuesday morning after being hospitalized for some time. He was 84.He died with his family at his side, a statement from the family said. Jackson rose from being an aide to Martin Luther King Jr. to being one of the most celebrated civil rights leaders in the U.S. and shifted the Democratic Party to embrace a multicultural approach to politics.
